_about: Public-domain Georg Joachim Zollikofer (1730-1788), Reformed preacher at Leipzig, in English translation (William Tooke and others, all translations printed 1796-1812), for the Word Hoard: Exercises of Piety, Sermons on the Dignity of Man, Sermons on Education, and Sermons on Prevalent Errors and Vices. The German originals are left out; this shelf is English only. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 96 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

zollikofer-exercises-piety: Exercises of piety. For the use of the enlightened and virtuous Christians (London : Johnson, 1796)
zollikofer-dignity-of-man: Sermons on the dignity of man, and the value of the objects principally (for T.N. Longman and O. Rees, 1802, 1802)
zollikofer-education: Sermons on education : on reflection, on the greatness of God in the works of nature and in the government of the world, on charity, and on various other topics, vol. 1 (London : Printed for Longman, Hurst, Rees, and Orme ..., 1806)
zollikofer-prevalent-errors: Sermons on prevalent errors and vices : and on various other topics, vol. 1 (London : Printed for Longman, Hurst, Rees, Orme, and Brown, 1812)
